name: atrium
description: Private self-hosted personal everything-app and AI agent hub

scripts.build: npm --prefix web run build && dotnet build -c Release -warnaserror api/Atrium.sln
scripts.test: node --test scripts/check-suppressions.test.mjs && npm --prefix web test && dotnet test api/Atrium.sln && npm --prefix web run typecheck
scripts.check:all: npm run check:suppressions && node --test scripts/check-suppressions.test.mjs && npm --prefix web test && dotnet build -c Release -warnaserror api/Atrium.sln && dotnet test -c Release --no-build api/Atrium.sln && npm --prefix web run typecheck && npm --prefix web run build
